name: Faithful Refresh
desc: The current cone, finally sitting on a proper macOS squircle with a warm off-white plate.

name: Inverted Orange
desc: Brand orange becomes the plate; a crisp white cone with orange stripes.

name: Graphite Pro
desc: Pro-app dark graphite plate (think Final Cut / Logic) with a luminous cone.

desc: One colour, one shape. White silhouette with a single negative stripe.

name: Sunset

desc: A true conical body with curved stripes and elliptical base.

desc: Photo-studio realism: glossy plastic, soft floor shadow, gentle vignette.

name: Lens

name: Aqua Candy
desc: A love letter to Mac OS X Aqua: jelly-glossy cone with a big highlight.

desc: Cone emitting audio arcs: equal weight on audio and video playback.

desc: A tiny display frame with the cone inside — reads as a video player instantly.

name: Holo
desc: Iridescent holographic plate with a chrome-white cone.

name: Hazard

name: Chrome

name: Terminal
desc: ASCII-art cone in a terminal window, for the command-line crowd.

name: Monogram V
desc: The cone flipped into a V for VLC — the stripes still say 'traffic cone'.

name: Mascot
desc: A friendly cone character with eyes and a smile. Kid-friendly and memorable.

name: Aurora Glass
desc: Dark glassmorphism: blurred aurora blobs under a frosted cone.

name: Material You
desc: Android 12+ tonal palette: soft peach container, deep-orange monochrome glyph.

name: Fluent
desc: Windows 11 Fluent style: soft gradient cone with a subtle acrylic base, made for the taskbar.

name: Night Sky
desc: A cone under a starry sky, with a warm glow on the horizon. Movie-night mood.

name: Wireframe
desc: 3D mesh wireframe of the cone, glowing on a dark grid. Engineering chic.

name: Retro Rainbow
desc: Six-stripe rainbow cone, a nod to 1980s Mac heritage.

desc: A single orange ribbon folds into a cone shape and a play triangle at once.

name: Tahoe Dark
desc: Dark-mode twin of Tahoe Layered: graphite plate, same layered cone and edge light.
